text: {"lessons":["My account is below its Period 1 value despite a late rebound; I should judge progress over a longer horizon, not infer a trend from a few monthly moves.","Because past price changes do not predict future changes, I should not buy or sell based only on recent gains or losses.","I made no trades across these periods, which avoided impulsive reactions; I should still review my holdings deliberately and rebalance only when there is a clear reason."]}
